evidence.description: The operative prohibition on Liens is qualified by a long enumerated 'except for' list (items (a) through (p)) plus a closing compliance/classification paragraph. Omission of any of these exceptions materially changes what the covenant actually prohibits.
evidence.sourceSpan: Create, incur, assume or suffer to exist any Lien upon any of its Property or revenues, whether now owned or hereafter acquired, except for:

evidence.description: Exception (a) is itself doubly qualified: the charges must be not yet due or contested in good faith, plus a proviso requiring adequate GAAP-conforming reserves to be maintained. Both qualifications must be captured for the exception to be represented accurately.
evidence.sourceSpan: Liens for taxes, assessments or charges not yet due or which are being contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings; provided that adequate reserves with respect thereto are maintained on the books of the Parent Borrower or its Subsidiaries, as the case may be, in conformity with GAAP

evidence.description: Exception (b) contains a temporal/event condition: the ordinary-course Liens are permitted only while not overdue for more than 30 days, or while being contested in good faith. The exception expires with the passage of time.
evidence.sourceSpan: carriers', warehousemen's, mechanics', materialmen's, repairmen's, supplier's or other like Liens arising in the ordinary course of business which are not overdue for a period of more than 30 days or which are being contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings

evidence.description: Permission for judgment Liens in exception (b) is conditioned on whether the judgment constitutes an Event of Default under clause (h) of Article VIII - the limiting condition is supplied entirely by cross-reference.
evidence.sourceSpan: Liens securing judgments to the extent not constituting an Event of Default pursuant to clause (h) of Article VIII

evidence.description: Exception (f) depends on the Lien being listed on Schedule 7.3(f) and on the secured Indebtedness being permitted by Section 7.2(e); the actual scope of the exception is incorporated from those schedules and cross-referenced covenants.
evidence.sourceSpan: Liens in existence on the Closing Date listed on Schedule 7.3(f) (and any replacements or extensions thereof), securing Indebtedness permitted by Section 7.2(e)

evidence.description: Exception (f) is subject to two provisos - no extension to additional Property after the Closing Date and no increase in secured Indebtedness - that condition continued availability of the exception.
evidence.sourceSpan: provided that no such Lien is spread to cover any additional Property after the Closing Date and that the amount of Indebtedness secured thereby is not increased

evidence.description: Exception (g) is gated on two provisos: the Lien must not cover other Property and the secured amount must never exceed 80% of the Property's fair market value as determined by a Responsible Officer at acquisition time.
evidence.sourceSpan: provided that (A) no such Lien shall extend to or cover any Property of the Parent Borrower or such Subsidiary other than the Property so acquired or financed, and (B) the principal amount of Indebtedness secured by any such Lien shall at no time exceed 80% of the fair market value (as determined in good faith by a Responsible Officer) of such Property at the time it was acquired (by purchase, construction or otherwise)

evidence.description: Exception (m) is a catch-all that is eligible only so long as dollar and asset-value thresholds are not exceeded, measured as of the date of incurrence - an explicit eligibility requirement with durational and measurement conditions.
evidence.sourceSpan: Liens not otherwise permitted by this Section 7.3 so long as neither (i) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of the obligations secured thereby nor (ii) the aggregate fair market value (determined as of the date such Lien is incurred) of the assets subject thereto exceeds (as to the Parent Borrower and all Subsidiaries) the greater of (A) $50,000,000 and (B) 3.0% of Consolidated Total Assets (measured on the date of incurrence of such Liens)

evidence.description: Exception (o) is conditioned on the disposition being 'pursuant to a Receivables Transfer Program in accordance with Section 7.5(k)'; the real limiting content is supplied by cross-reference to Section 7.5(k) and to the Program's terms.
evidence.sourceSpan: Liens on accounts receivable or related ancillary rights and assets sold, transferred, encumbered or otherwise disposed of, or purported to have been sold, transferred, encumbered or otherwise disposed of pursuant to a Receivables Transfer Program in accordance with Section 7.5(k)

evidence.description: The closing paragraph's classification/reclassification permission is triggered only 'in the event that' the Lien meets the criteria of the permitted-Lien categories - an explicit event dependency governing how the covenant is applied.
evidence.sourceSpan: in the event that a Lien securing an item of Indebtedness (or any portion thereof) meets the criteria of one or more of the categories of permitted Liens described in Section 7.3(a) through (p), the Parent Borrower shall, in its sole discretion, classify or reclassify, or later divide, classify or reclassify, such Lien securing such item of Indebtedness (or any portion thereof) in any manner that complies with this covenant
